description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling 'RetrievePolicyEntries' commands in a policy management system. It extends an abstract class designed for policy query commands and defines logic to retrieve policy entries, returning either the entries or an error if the policy is not found.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyEntriesStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a command strategy for retrieving policy entries based on a given command and context, extending AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the logic to fetch policy entries based on the provided context, policy, and command, returning a Result containing either the PolicyEvent or an error.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Calculates the next entity tag for the policy entries, facilitating change tracking.
